type Dict = { [key: string]?: number };
interface Table {
  [key: string]?: number;
}
class Store {
  [key: string]?: number;
}
type Removed = { [k: string]-?: number };
type Added = { [k: number]+?: number };
type Mapped = { [K in 'a']?: number };
type Required = { [K in 'a']-?: number };
const d: Dict = {};
console.log(d);
